notes: Chevrolet Silverado 1500 pickup, 2017 model year. The fuse tables are the manual's single set for every Silverado it covers and it says not every fuse is fitted; diesel (Duramax), bi-fuel and eAssist trucks have their own supplements, so check the fuse and tank rows against the truck in hand.

gaps: The file on chevytrucks.org is named 2017 Silverado 3500, but its cover and every page header read 2017 Silverado owner manual and its capacity table lists the 1500, 2500 and 3500 series.
The fuse tables are not specific to the 1500; the manual shows one set for all trucks it covers.
No fuse amp ratings, battery group size or CCA, alternator or starter ratings were found, so none are claimed.
The manual does not say whether the cooling fans are electric or clutch-driven on each engine; it also lists a cooling fan clutch fuse (42) and relay (71).
The radio sections name a base radio and a base radio with touchscreen; no maker or part number was found.
Only the 2017 manual was read; 2014-2016 and 2018 trucks were not checked.
method: Chevrolet Silverado Owner Manual, 2017 model year: GM publication 9956065 in every page header, printed part number 23476161 A, 2016 General Motors LLC copyright and GM trademark notice. PDF copy on chevytrucks.org.
It is plainly GM's own manual (cover, part numbers, copyright), so the chevytrucks.org copy is kept as the source.
GM's own PDF host (contentdelivery.ext.gm.com) returned HTTP 403, so a GM-hosted copy could not be opened; archive.org searches by title and by 9956065 found no 2017 Silverado owner's manual.
PDF page numbers are used throughout; the printed page number is one lower.

Engine compartment fuse block (driver side of the engine bay): PDF pp. 391-393 for the intro and fuse usage table, p. 394 for its relays. The two-column tables were read from rendered pages (rows 58, 74 and 76 on p. 393).
Right instrument panel block: heading on PDF p. 394, fuse table pp. 395-396. Left instrument panel block: heading on p. 396, fuse table pp. 397-398.
Fuel tank sizes: PDF p. 470 (Technical Data, Capacities). Battery text: PDF p. 379. Radio: PDF pp. 184-185 (overviews), 190 and 192 (AM-FM Radio sections).
A chevytrucks.org file named 2016 Silverado LD was read by the researcher and rejected: its header dates it to 2019. Firestone battery lookup page returned HTTP 403 to the researcher; not used.

comps.spec: Original battery is maintenance free (the manual says not to open the cap or add fluid); a replacement is picked by the number on the original battery label (PDF p. 379)
Starter circuit: fuse position 11 labelled Starter, and relay position 68 labelled Starter, in the engine compartment fuse block (PDF pp. 392, 394)
Cooling fan 1: fuse position 12 in the engine compartment fuse block (PDF p. 392)
Cooling fan 2: fuse position 13 in the engine compartment fuse block (PDF p. 392)

Fuel pump: fuse position 18 in the engine compartment fuse block; the same block lists fuel pump power module (21), fuel pump 2 (41) and fuel pump prime (76) fuses and relays for fuel pump (59), fuel pump 2 (66) and fuel pump prime (75) (PDF pp. 392-394)
Fuel tank 26.0 US gal (98.4 L) on 1500 standard and short box; 34.0 US gal (128.7 L) on 1500 long box (PDF p. 470)

Engine compartment fuse block (driver side): fuse positions 1 to 58, 74 and 76, with relays 59 to 73 and 75 listed separately. Right instrument panel block (passenger side): positions up to 52. Left block (driver side): up to 50. Each is listed by usage (PDF pp. 391-398)

AM/FM radio (SiriusXM if equipped) in the infotainment system, described as a base radio and a base radio with touchscreen; radio is fuse 18 and amplifier fuse 36 in the right instrument panel fuse block (PDF pp. 184-185, 190, 192, 395)

sources.title: Chevrolet Silverado Owner Manual, 2017 (GMNA-Localizing-U.S./Canada/Mexico-9956065, CRC 4/29/16), PDF copy on chevytrucks.org
